components.name: Ephemeral AES-256 key-encryption key
components.description: A random 32-byte AES key created for each Transit BYOK import. It wraps the PKCS#8 private key with AES-KWP and is itself wrapped with the Transit RSA wrapping key.

components.name: OpenBao (Transit and KV v2)
components.description: OpenBao server providing the Transit secrets engine and the KV v2 fallback mount used by this package. Version 2.7.2 is the version verified by the live check.
